Callout.Name: Front Business - Stolen Handsets
Callout.Message: Shop believed to be re-selling stolen handsets.

Script.Line: Every handset has a box and every box has a receipt.
I buy in bulk from a wholesaler. I do not ask where a wholesaler gets them.
Take the books. Take all of the books.

Lines.Approach: Every handset in that window came from somewhere it should not have been. Ask for the books.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
